reviews.author: Niamh Magee
reviews.text: Hugely disappointed by this place. It's got great reviews from friends, but I cannot see for the life of me why that would be. The food is extraordinarily bland - I went with a friend who got their spiciest dish and it had no spice to it whatsoever. I got the chicken ramen, and when it first arrived, the chicken was raw. The server explained that the pink colour I was noticing was because it was marinated in pink gin before it was cooked, but that they'd be happy to replace it. My second serving had the same issue. While it wasn't pink, it had the texture of severely undercooked chicken and was translucent in some areas (I've attached a photo, though it was more visible in person). Another server explained that this was due to it being chicken thigh, which makes it more "succulent". I've eaten a lot of chicken thigh in my life and it has never had that texture when cooked. Safe to say I didn't eat anything further. Every time a customer is seated, a staff member bangs a drum. This is weird, but amusing at first, but quickly becomes incredibly grating. The whole place is decorated like an overdone gimmick of Japan, making it feel more like a cheap Disney display than a comfortable place to eat. I was also disappointed to learn that the £5 ramen offer you get for downloading their app does not apply in this location for whatever reason. The staff were an absolute delight, and did not charge me for my disastrous meal. They are attentive and friendly, and I can only assume the failures of this place are due to it being a poorly managed chain.

The chicken in the ramen tasted freezer burnt and the vegan bacon had an aftertaste of burnt tires… very strange. I was excited to try this place since people seem to like it but I wouldn’t recommend the ramen. I’ve yet to try the sushi though, so maybe thats good? reviews.text: We were served by Lesley throughout the evening, and she was absolutely wonderful from the moment she came to our table until we left. Attentive, engaging and accommodating, Lesley was patient, genuinely pleasant and always served with a smile. But what really made the evening was her wit and quick banter. She had all three of us in fits of laughter — and I mean proper, hard-to-breathe laughter! 🤣👌🏾 Lesley is exactly the type of person you want looking after you. She understood the perfect balance between great customer service and the needs of the business, making everything feel completely seamless. This was our first time dining at Maki & Ramen, but we were already planning our next visit before we had even left! The restaurant is vibrant, well designed and has a great atmosphere, with plenty of space for diners. And the food? Absolutely fantastic. We tried a sizeable portion of the menu and genuinely were not disappointed. Everything we ordered was delicious, and there is still plenty more we want to try. Great food, great atmosphere and an outstanding server in Lesley. What more could you ask for? We will definitely be back — hopefully Lesley will be on shift! ☝🏾😄👌🏾

reviews.text: It was my first visiting in Birmingham so I thought of trying food at your place. Very disappointed and felt like I was ignored and not welcomed. It was really busy so I requested the male manager (British tall man) that any chance I could sit in the corner I didn’t wanna sit in the middle of the crowd. He refused it and said that table is only for three people you can sit and was trying to seat me in the middle of a big group. I then refused and again requested to sit in the corner. Finally he did, no one came to take my order, felt like I was targeted. While I was waiting to be served there were some Japanese couple came and he gave them a big table but it was only two people so I thought he is discriminating me. Finally a server came, she didn’t even ask whether I have any allergies, she took my order. I called the female manager and said that I have gluten intolerance so could you please guide me or explain the option but she didn’t. I ordered a stater, a main, a drink and a glass of water. Main came first no drinks at all, starter came later still no water or drink at all. By the time I started eating I asked more than 3 times that whether I could have my drinks at least. Since I got allergy, after having the food, I was waiting to catch my train to come back home. I had server vomiting and diarrhoea in the train. It was because of their ignorance and careless behaviour. I said to that Chinese lady manager that I have allergy she didn’t even care about me. I’m gonna severely take action against their behaviour which is not suitable for the hospitality and I’m looking forward to the head office to contact me to discuss about my health issue. There was another man who was trying to get the payment, he was like forcing me to pay the 10% service charge as if they gave the best guest experience. I would like to claim my full refund that I paid for the meal and I need a proper explanation form the management.

reviews.author: San Dee (Sandee)
reviews.text: We visited on a Thursday evening, it wasn't too busy which was nice. The food was good, we had a steak ramen, a chicken yakisoba and Tokyo rolls. It was generally good, I wouldn't rush to go there again. We also had a lychee lemonade with bubble tea. It tasted really nice but the portion was tiny, again for the price. Should have been a full cup but it was tiny. It let itself down with the price, it was really expensive for what you get. Other than that nice location, good staff.

reviews.author: Crow
reviews.text: The food here was ok. I had a bowl of ramen, which was alright and my friends had chicken katsu curry and sushi. Apparently the sushi was very good, but I feel like the ramen was mediocre - lots of other places do much better ramen for cheaper. They have a different kitchen for their sushi so if you're in a group ordering a mix of sushi and hot mains, be aware that it could take longer for one to arrive. We waited for quite a long time before my friend was served the sushi she ordered. The atmosphere was also very nice

reviews.text: I guess this is the worst Japanese restaurant I’ve ever been. The tuna and white fish were fishy and I even accidentally swallowed a bone from the nigiri. The rice was bland and cold, even worse than takeaway sushi. I have to say the atmosphere was good and chill. However, I realized the floor and sushi bar were quite dirty. Overall, I’d rather go to Eat Tokyo on the next street, cheaper and better food.

reviews.author: Rayn Chan
reviews.text: Poor imitation of omakase What is japanese food? I can't say i know it all, but this place certainly knows nothing. Firstly, their signature 'hand roll'. If you have had any experience with sushi before you will know that temaki is supposed to be ice cream cone shaped with lots of rice and sashimi on top - the point for it being a filling snack/starter. However, their ones were small (it already looks small enough but when you grab it you can feel that its not even filled with rice) and then they tried to impress me by saying some fancy words, even though with it being called negitoro (shredded fatty tuna) it was just normal thin supermarket tuna. Poor fish got slaughtered just to be put in that trash then fell out because it wasnt even rolled tight enough. Secondly, the service. Its so obvious that they prioritize looks over quality (classic tourist scam) but they don't even give you any water, soysauce plate or wasabi despite it appearing as a fancy cuisine. When the food was served the waitress had a dead look on her face and mumbled the names of the sashimi really quickly. I might have wrote alot already, but guess what? Theres still more. I'll just bullet point them. • Cheap supermarket soysauce and wasabi • Putting avocado in sushi • Most customers were european people (not being racist) who came for instagram posts, showing what kind of people would actually come to this place. • No actual asian chefs • Expensive ( £10 + for just some cheap tuna and £30 for a plate of miniature sashimi) The only good things were that the food didn't take that long to arrive and i guess the beard guy was chill. If you want actual authentic japanese food, don't come here. I'd recommend RAI which is nearby and sells the same thing.
